observation: Architecture critique (2 rounds) caught a CRITICAL the plan missed: plan ran a forward scan (verify the 18 spec-named tokens) but never the inverse sweep the gate itself enforces — 2 unaccounted dead tokens (--surface-2 live, --bg-canvas comment-only) would have made the gate exit 1 on a clean tree, breaking every future Track AI workpackage. Round 2 also caught a false provenance claim (h1 'byte-identical' restoration was actually a 26→24px normalization citing the wrong source file). Cost ~2 critique rounds; prevented shipping a broken gate.

TDD red phase: 56 gate-contract unit tests written before implementation (token extraction, line-number reporting, comment-strip false positives); all passed on first green run. Guard script reused nimmly-guard precedent (file walker, testable exports, --check CLI) — zero new infrastructure. Protected ThreadSections test updated in lockstep with a one-line matcher diff; structural assertions intact.

Code review round 1 was NOT DONE purely on visual-proof gaps — zero code findings: TaskSheet screenshots showed an empty 'No bets yet' page (sheet never opened), SettingsAssistant screenshot was a 404, knowledge-heading proof missing. Builder green phase captured screenshots without looking at whether the target surface was actually reached. Fix round was evidence-capture only (~1h, Playwright via designsystem harness + mocked routes). Pattern for Track AI: the proof bar is LOOKING at the rendered target state; capturing the route is not capturing the surface.

Phases: architecture → 2 critique rounds (+1 revision) → red (40→56 tests) → green (~91min, ~419 tool uses) → review NOT DONE → evidence fix (~15min) → review DONE → retro. 18 commits (9 code, 9 docs).
